newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA's French airlines in talks with unions.
newsitem.headline: BA's French airlines in talks with unions.

text.p: Some 200 striking cockpit crew from British Airways' French subsidaries TAT and Air Liberte, who occupied its Paris offices on Friday, left overnight to allow talks between management and union representatives to take place, French afternoon daily Le Monde said on Saturday.

The workers returned to their union offices after managing director Marc Rochet, earlier locked in his office, said he would not hold talks with the unions until the protesting members left Air Liberte's premises, the paper said.
Neither airline officials nor union representatives were immediately available for comment.
The cockpit crew members, who have been on indefinite strike since April 9, are protesting against cost cutting measures aimed at bringing the carriers to profitability.
Le Monde said that because of the strike, the airlines' management expected only 65 percent of scheduled flights to fly on Saturday and Sunday.
